method: Segmented-CN breakpoint detection (QDNAseq hg19 30kb bins, ~0.1x sWGS). Breakpoint = segmented relative-CN level shift >= 0.1 between adjacent bins.

signature_definitions.chromothripsis_like_focal_catastrophe: >=50 net-gained BPs, >=40% on one chromosome, >=3 oscillating CN levels there (focal, clustered, oscillating)
signature_definitions.dispersed_stochastic_CIN: >=50 net-gained BPs spread across >=8 chromosomes, <30% on any one

honest_ceiling: sWGS/QDNAseq resolves LARGE CNA breakpoints only. This architecture readout is DESCRIPTIVE/hypothesis-generating; it cannot prove single-catastrophe chromothripsis vs progressive rearrangement (needs WGS SV/junction resolution). 'chromothripsis_like' is a pattern label, not a diagnosis.
